item.title: Raised with Love, now giving love: Youth pastor Nancy Cakacaka shares her story on fijivillage HerStory at 7 tonight
item.description: Nancy Cakacaka is a senior pastor’s wife, a youth pastor, a mentor and a woman dedicated to shaping the next generation. Lovingly known as Aunty Nancy by many young people in her community, she has devoted much of her life to guiding youths, strengthening their Christian faith and encouraging them to make positive choices.
item.content:encoded:
Nancy Cakacaka is a senior pastor’s wife, a youth pastor, a mentor and a woman dedicated to shaping the next generation.

Lovingly known as Aunty Nancy by many young people in her community, she has devoted much of her life to guiding youths, strengthening their Christian faith and encouraging them to make positive choices.

On this week’s fijivillage HerStory with Temalesi Vono, Nancy opens up about her own journey, from growing up in Bua with her grandparents after her parents separated, to the values of love, faith and discipline that shaped her upbringing.

She also shares her experiences working with young people, the challenges families and youths face today, and her message to young people to listen to their parents, stay grounded in their faith and know that they are loved.

Join us at 7pm tonight for fijivillage HerStory with Temalesi Vono, as we hear Aunty Nancy's story.

item.title: No charges laid for suspects of the death of Sigatoka man, who was horse-riding with sons on Sunday
item.description: Navitalai Naivalurua · 12/08/2026 No charges have been laid in relation to the death of 38-year-old Vimal Vikash Nand, who was allegedly assaulted in Sigatoka on Sunday.
item.content:encoded:
Navitalai Naivalurua · 12/08/2026

No charges have been laid in relation to the death of 38-year-old Vimal Vikash Nand, who was allegedly assaulted in Sigatoka on Sunday.

Nand later died as a result of the alleged assault and he was laid to rest at Koromumu Cemetery today.

A father and son were taken into custody on Monday in relation to the alleged incident and Police have yet to release any information on them, despite continuous communications sent to them.

It is alleged that Nand and his sons were assaulted on Sunday by the two suspects following a confrontation over an incident involving one of Nand’s farm animals.

A resident had earlier told fijivillage News that the suspects were allegedly drunk at the time of the incident.

item.title: Cockroach found in a loaf of bread
item.description: Following the complaint, the Council carried out an inspection of the bakery and identified several concerns relating to food safety and hygiene. The Council says it then issued a Non-Compliance Notice to the business, while the matter has been referred to the Suva City Council for further action as well.
item.content:encoded:
Following the complaint, the Council carried out an inspection of the bakery and identified several concerns relating to food safety and hygiene.

The Council says it then issued a Non-Compliance Notice to the business, while the matter has been referred to the Suva City Council for further action as well.

They say that the affected consumer was also given a refund.

The Council adds food safety is not negotiable and will continue to take firm action against businesses that put consumers at risk.

item.title: Emotional farewell for Sigatoka man who died following an alleged assault
item.description: As 38-year-old Vimal Vikash Nand who was allegedly assaulted on Sunday was laid to rest in an emotional ceremony at the Koromumu Cemetery in Sigatoka today, charges are yet to be laid against those who beat him up. Hundreds of people gathered in Kulukulu to pay their last respects to the Sigatoka family today.
item.content:encoded:
As 38-year-old Vimal Vikash Nand who was allegedly assaulted on Sunday was laid to rest in an emotional ceremony at the Koromumu Cemetery in Sigatoka today, charges are yet to be laid against those who beat him up.

Hundreds of people gathered in Kulukulu to pay their last respects to the Sigatoka family today.

While speaking during the funeral service, a close friend of the family said Nand was a kind hearted and a loving man who will always be remembered for his hardworking and kind nature.

He says he was a person of a good character and was very dedicated to his work and family.

He adds Nand was a quite and gentle person who was respectful to others and loved sports.

The close friend says Nand was also a great supporter and a true fan of the Fijian Drua team and the Spain Football team.

It is alleged that Nand and his sons were assaulted on Sunday by the two suspects following a confrontation over an incident involving one of Nand's farm animals.
